title: lithocarpus mindanaensis
intro: Lithocarpus mindanaensis, commonly known as the Mindanao Lithocarpus or the Philippine tanbark oak, is a species of evergreen tree in the family Fagaceae. This plant is traditionally used for various medicinal purposes, providing health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help alleviate conditions like arthritis and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Lithocarpus mindanaensis include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory agent, antimicrobial agent, and antiseptic, making it useful in wound healing and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are commonly found in various parts of the tree, including the bark and leaves.
